### Documento oficial (copiado por la tarea): https://www.eit.europa.eu/node/22119
EIT Community New European Bauhaus - Connect NEB & Co-create NEB 2027 open call. Open: 15/07/2026 09.00 CET - 30/09/2026 17.00 CET. Online information session: 3 September 2026.
Connect NEB supports community-led initiatives that test new ideas, activate local communities, and experiment with participatory approaches, living labs, and new forms of governance.
Connect NEB: grant up to €15,300, co-funding €2,700, total project budget €18,000. One beneficiary.
Connect NEB is ideal for: community organisations, citizen-led initiatives, NGOs, social innovators, artists and designers, SMEs, research groups.
Co-create NEB supports partnerships that deliver place-based transformation of neighbourhood public spaces through community participation and municipal collaboration.
Co-create NEB: grant up to €49,300, co-funding €8,700, total project budget €58,000. Consortium of 2–4 partners. At least one municipality, region or affiliated entity.
Co-create NEB is ideal for: municipalities, public authorities, NGOs, universities, SMEs, community organisations, multi-sector partnerships.
Selected projects receive onboarding and kick-off sessions, capacity-building workshops, peer learning, network access, communication and visibility opportunities, an in-person gathering.

### Documento oficial (copiado por la tarea): https://www.climate-kic.org/open-call/connect-neb-and-co-create-neb-2027/
Deadline: on or before September 30, 2026 (17:00 CEST). Connect NEB: up to €15,300. Co-create NEB: up to €49,300. Co-create NEB: partnerships between communities, municipalities and other local actors.

### Documento oficial (copiado por la tarea): https://www.vlaio.be/nl/nieuws/europese-steun-voor-buurtgerichte-projecten
Connect NEB: subsidie tot € 15.300, cofinanciering € 2.700, totaal projectbudget € 18.000. Eén begunstigde.
Co-create NEB: subsidie tot € 49.300, cofinanciering € 8.700, totaal projectbudget € 58.000. Consortium van 2–4 partners. Minstens één gemeente, regio of gelieerde entiteit.
Deadline: 30 september 2026 om 17.00 uur CET.
